in_marathi.name: Bhari
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhari is derived from the Sanskrit word bharati, which means ‘to carry’ or ‘to bear’. This name is often given to a girl who is expected to carry the weight of her responsibilities and family duties with strength and grace.
